tools.name: clear_webhooks
tools.description: Permanently delete every capture in a bucket. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: configure_webhook_response
tools.description: Set the status, content type, body, safe response headers, and a delay up to 10 seconds returned by the webhook endpoint.

tools.name: create_webhook_bucket
tools.description: Create an anonymous temporary webhook capture bucket. The returned bucket ID is a bearer capability and expires after 15 days of inactivity.

tools.name: delete_webhook_bucket
tools.description: Permanently delete a bucket and all of its captures. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Read one webhook capture scoped to its bucket. Sensitive headers and query values are redacted by default.

tools.name: get_webhook_bucket
tools.description: Read a bucket name and its configured HTTP response settings.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhook capture summaries in newest-first order using cursor pagination.

tools.name: wait_for_webhook
tools.description: Return the latest capture, wait for a newer capture, or report received=false after the timeout.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_webhook_bucket" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Create an anonymous temporary webhook capture bucket. The returned bucket ID is a bearer capability and expires after 15 days of inactivity.
